acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest host Bim Adewunmi talks to her cousin Kamyl about a funny thing Kamyl did when she was small, regarding a dog named Foxy.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc:
Comedian Atsuko Okatsuka moved suddenly from Japan to the U.S. when she was eight years old, and has long joked that it was because her grandmother kidnapped her from her dad. But she'd never talked to anyone in her family about what had actually happened.
Tickets for Atsuko’s comedy tour at atsukocomedy.com. Atsuko’s HBO Special is called “ The Intruder.”
acts.credits: By Atsuko Okatsuka; Produced by Ira Glass, Miki Meek, and Diane Wu
acts.title: I Coulda Grown Big in Japan

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Producer Emmanuel Dzotsi has a tale about something he avoids at all costs, even though it seems to follow him everywhere he goes.
acts.title: Killing Me Softly

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Writer Tamsyn Muir spent her childhood craving a world that she could not find on earth. So as an adult, she just created it. And it was perfect. Until she became the one person who couldn't go there.
More about The Locked Tomb series at thelockedtomb.com.
acts.title: Lost In Space
